pages.title: https://www.crawfordscampground.com/ | RV & Tent Camping in Beaver County, PA | Crawford's Camping Park
pages.lines:
RV Sites
Our full hookup RV sites offer individually metered electric, water, and sewer connections for nightly, weekly, monthly, or seasonal stays. Spacious sites make it easy to settle in, whether you're passing through or staying all season.
View RV Sites
Tent Sites
Our no-hookup tent sites offer a quiet, rustic camping experience close to our pool, playground, and hiking trails. Nightly rates make it easy to plan a short getaway in Darlington, PA.
View Tent Sites

pages.title: https://crawfordscampground.com/rates | RV & Tent Site Rates and Fees | Crawford's Camping Park
pages.lines:
Rates
Nightly, weekly, monthly, and seasonal rates for RV and tent camping in Darlington, PA
Nightly	$50 + electric
Weekly	$225 + electric
Monthly
$50 refundable deposit required. Monthly campers may live in their campers 24/7 and are restricted to two (2) vehicles per site.	$650 + electric
Seasonal
Seasonal campers may stay weekends, vacations, and holidays, but may not live in their unit. There is a 115 day per season limit. The seasonal fee includes water and sewer.	$1,850 + electric
Winter
We have a limited number of winterized sites available by the month or season.	Call for rates
Tent Nightly (No Hookups)	$40
Shelter Rental	Call for rates
Camping Policies
Primitive tent sites $40 per night. Weekly/monthly tent rates are not available. Your tent must be moved if you camp longer than 4 days.
Electric

pages.title: https://www.moyersgrovecg.com/campground-rates/ | Campground Rates for Moyer's Grove |
pages.lines:
Daily Rates (Sunday-Thursday)
Electric and Water $50.00
Electric, Water and Sewer $60.00
50 AMP Hookups $10.00 Extra
Air Conditioning or Electric Heater $5.00
Extra Adults (Age 18 and older) $5.00 per Day or $10 Overnight
Weekends, Holidays & Special Event Rates (Friday-Saturday)
(Holidays include Memorial Day, 4th of July, Labor Day, Make-A-Wish Funtastic Weekend and all of the Halloween Parties)
Electric and Water $70.00
Electric, Water and Sewer $80.00
’50 Amp Hookups $10.00 Extra
Weekly Rates
Water and Electric 7 nights $420.00
Water, Electric and Sewer 7 nights $480.00
NOTICE:
We apologize for any inconvenience.
Visitors – per day $5.00 (18 and Older)
Visitors – band nights, holidays, overnight $10.00 (18 and Older)
ALL VISITORS MUST BE REGISTERED AND PAY AT OUR OFFICE UPON ARRIVAL. ALL VISITORS MUST OBTAIN A PARKING PASS AND PARK IN THE DESIGNATED PARKING LOT FOR VISITORS, NOT AT CAMPSITES. ONLY ONE CAR OR TRUCK PER SITE
Cancellation Policy:
A full refund will be given, minus a $10.00 administration fee for canceled reservations. To receive a refund, you must cancel at least 14 days prior to your arrival date. Cancellations made less than 14 days prior to arrival date and no shows will lose their entire deposit.
Camping Cabin & Trailer Rentals:
$115.00 per night. Cabin and trailers sleep a family of 4. Must supply own linens, cookware, dishes, towels, utensils, food, etc. $115.00 Security deposit must be paid in advance. Check In time is 3:00 p.m. and Check Out is 11:00 a.m. NO PETS OR SMOKING ALLOWED IN CABIN OR RV RENTALS. Our policy is that if a camper brings a pet in or around the rental unit or cabin, they will be asked to leave without a refund.
Cabin and Trailer Cancellation Policy:
Refund given with 1 month notice. Less than 1 month requires re-rental of cabin or trailer for refund. No less than 2 weeks notice. $10.00 handling fee for each canceled reservation.
We will NOT honor discount clubs on weekends, holidays or special events.
